name: preview-card-3v
title: Preview Card 3v: Dog-ear, clear fold
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. 1v with the preview clipped away from the fold, so nothing shows under the folded corner.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
